name: Company Market Scan
summary: A cited snapshot of public company and market information.
audience: Small teams deciding whether to evaluate a market or vendor.
limits: One market or vendor category per order; sector input is 1 to 500 characters.
Public business sources only; no personal contact data or private records.
Descriptive summary only; not investment, legal, or accounting advice.
privacy_terms: No account or contact details are required. Do not submit passwords, payment data, personal contact data, or confidential information. The local test checkout uses a deterministic fixture and stores no real payment credentials.

sector.description: Market or vendor category to examine.

verification_promise: Every material factual claim has a resolving public citation; source dates and unchecked areas are reported.
refund_rule: Release the authorization if citation validation fails; refund a captured test order if the delivered report materially misses its stated scope.

sample.description: Public-company scan sample with source, reported facts, and unchecked areas.

notes: Use public business sources only; no personal contact data or scraping against source terms.
The sample is a descriptive summary of a public SEC filing, not investment, legal, or accounting advice.
